scope: Only exact frozen B internals, A10/A25, Q1/Q2, and .39 source/derivation; no peer or postcritic material, target acquisition, decoder, simulation or experiment.
question: Does two-call reuse of p and perceived MarkerOf(p) at uncleared D establish two origin-specific arrivals?
answer: No. Distinct invocation and readout identities establish two stated attempts/reports, but do not establish two causally distinct arrivals from the respective origins.

frozen_constraints.note: This is an audit of the exact protocol, not a claim that the manuscript lacks clearing instructions globally.

countercase.kind: Small hypothetical physical world, not a new semantic rule or empirical finding
countercase.initial_state: D initially free of marker; A-to-D path communicates; B entrance can be released but downstream B-to-D path is obstructed; MarkerOf(p) can persist at D through the second wait.

events.R_actions: Close B entrance, release A/D entrances, place p at A, wait Delta.
Close A entrance, release B/D entrances, place same p at B, wait Delta.

countercase.why_no_R_contradiction: Opening the selected entrance does not guarantee every downstream segment communicates. R expressly does not guarantee an arrival; it has no between-call marker-clearing step.
countercase.minimal_observation_model: PresentAfter(D)=ResidualBefore(D) OR NewArrival(D). In the second call set ResidualBefore=true and NewArrival=false.
not_added_to_B: No assumption that observation removes the marker
No automatic new-arrival inference from waiting

event_index_vs_signal_provenance.stated_semantic_object: u2=ObservedArrival(e2,p,D) remains the exact frozen textual assertion; it is not renamed Presence(D).
event_index_vs_signal_provenance.observable_countercase: The observer perceives MarkerOf(p) at D at both observation times; the physical causal source remains e1.
event_index_vs_signal_provenance.non_entailment: e1!=e2 and two positive perception records do not imply NewArrivalFrom(A) and NewArrivalFrom(B). Event-indexed storage alone does not tag the physical signal.
event_index_vs_signal_provenance.meaning_limit: If Arrival entails fresh e2-caused arrival, that statement is false in the countercase. If it reports a perception attributed to the selected call, that attribution can be mistaken. Neither option is established by the observation alone.
event_index_vs_signal_provenance.Q1_Q2_limit: DAIIIN/CHEDY and Q2 LDALOR/CTHOL state a paired route conclusion under the proposed semantic story; source identity preservation, equal waiting intervals and repeated u2 reference cannot rule out retained e1 signal.

line39_positive_reference.frozen_row_effect: settle c4; positive reference output uC4 under A10

line39_positive_reference.limit: Calling c4 a positive observation exceeds what SHEY supplies. In frozen B it is assumption-dependent modeled output, not independent manuscript evidence of an observed positive control. No observation/reset rule is added.

outcomes_and_research_decisions.condition: Retain B as a hypothesis about what the text asserts, allowing a historical procedure to make an invalid causal inference.
outcomes_and_research_decisions.decision: Keep B only as the same heavily assumed exploratory C0 text account; reject any claim that its two-call observer isolates both origin routes. No word confirmation, reserve opening or semantic winner follows.

outcomes_and_research_decisions.condition: Require B to provide a physically valid origin-specific diagnostic before semantic selection.
outcomes_and_research_decisions.decision: Current frozen B does not meet that causal-capacity requirement. Do not select or confirm it on this protocol; any future washout/provenance improvement would be a separately declared new model, not an edit to B.

outcomes_and_research_decisions.condition: Assume two event-indexed Arrival assertions are independently true.
outcomes_and_research_decisions.decision: A paired route story can be stated conditionally, but the truth assumption cannot be justified by the persistence-vulnerable observer. Retain the missing independent provenance requirement and no semantic preference.

outcomes_and_research_decisions.condition: An independent admitted constraint were to exclude marker persistence or establish call-specific provenance.
outcomes_and_research_decisions.decision: That changed input could make the persistence countercase inadmissible and permit reassessing causal capacity. No such constraint is present in frozen B; this audit neither seeks new data nor adds it.

outcomes_and_research_decisions.condition: A true lexical/grammar contradiction were independently demonstrated, rather than an invalid causal procedure alone.
outcomes_and_research_decisions.decision: Reject the exact conflicting frozen lexical/construction reading. This persistence countercase and the A10-dependent .39 output do not themselves demonstrate such a lexical contradiction.

historical_limit: FT_HISTORICAL_CONTENT.md describes an asserted garlic placement/odor/diagnosis relation and explicitly endorses no physiological efficacy. Possible historical inaccuracy does not alone falsify a translation hypothesis; no historical text gives B a carryover exclusion.
scientific_decision_now: The event/procedure/component type contrast remains a conditional authored semantic distinction, not independent causal evidence or a selected meaning. Frozen B cannot demonstrate two origin-specific arrivals with its stated observation protocol.
